mistakes.note: Ilse says the pickers will be out three more days, yet the harvest feast is Tuesday, the next night; Anselm later sets the roof for Friday 'when the pickers are off the hill'.
Mara's thanks and question are printed under Anselm's name, with an invented line about letters written to her; the reader has to work out who is speaking.
Anselm comes back to set the bottle down though he left it on the washstand in M21, and in M27 takes up a glass he had already set down.
Bette is said to look at Mara 'before she answered him', but her answer never comes; Anselm speaks in its place.

Anselm brings the founders' papers to the chapel saying she left them on the sill, though they were on the chapel sill she was walking to; and Mara has her sponge in the office though she left it on the bucket in the chapel.
Anselm is drawn barefoot in the chapel in the morning though he came up the path in boots; his looks record kept 'barefoot, no boots' from the night until round 30.
Several scenes (M8, M44, M60, M72, M78) are drawn as photographs, not the watercolour style, and at M8 Anselm holds two bottles and no glasses.
Anselm shouts 'both of you' when only Mara is on the ridge.
Mara grabs a burning branch with her bare hands, a deed past the move that costs her the burns.
No fire line between them, no burns, and Anselm covers his face instead of shouting down to her.
Ilse is drawn at the foot of the stairs while the narration has her at the top.
The folder of Ilse's husband's papers is recorded as gone though the page never has Mara hand it over, and the next picture still shows it under her arm.
PC status drops the burns on both hands, keeping only the split right palm, though nothing healed.
Anselm's looks gain a passing smear of tar on one wrist.
Ilse's thread says she asked Anselm to drive Mara to town for the founders' papers and he agreed, which never happened on the page; the papers were already at the chapel.
Anselm's and Bette's threads put him on the top terrace 'with the brigade' before any brigade has come; Victor has only just gone to fetch it.
Anselm's 'now knows' entries are written in first person ('Mara showed me', 'I hauled Mara off'), and round 3 adds one that only he knows his grandmother hired Mara.
A Choice has Mara say Bette walks that path every morning, which she has no way to know.
Victor, a guest at the house and after the land since spring, doesn't know Ilse when she comes down the drive.
Bette on the south slope has not noticed a fire that has burned two terraces and sent a brown column over the hill for an hour.

choices.reason: Three distinct, fitting options nearly every round, and picks bent the story (tar today rather than Friday, following the prints to the office); one Choice assumed what Mara couldn't know.

surprise.reason: The bucket, the prints and Bette's shifting lie land from what was set up out of sight, and the later skim quietly plants the deed, but the fire and Victor came from the bench's Edit and World Change.

threads.reason: Bette's sabotage moves well with story time, but the sale never touches the page, Ilse's deed story and failing heart are deferred round after round, and the romance thread stalls once day breaks.

characters.reason: Anselm is consistently guarded and short then sorry, Bette lies in layers and keeps her secret; Victor not knowing Ilse is a lapse, and Anselm's 'my own house' refrain gets worn.

continuity.reason: No break, but a run of small slips a careful reader catches: the bottle and glass, the papers and sponge in the wrong place, sneakers as boots, 'both of you', Bette blind to the fire, three days against a Tuesday feast.

pacing.reason: Each reply adds a fact or a turn and the fire stretch drives hard; the night scene circles the same who-gives-ground argument a few beats too long.

prose.reason: Vivid, sensory and in one voice, but the 'I'll not' idiom is in every mouth including the developer's, and the second reply mislabels Mara's lines as Anselm's.

pictures.reason: The right people and moments mostly, with good likenesses, but five scenes drift to photographs, Anselm is barefoot in the morning chapel, the fire scene misses the fire and Ilse stands in the wrong place.

secrets.reason: The sale, Ilse's heart and the deed stay hidden, and the sabotage reaches Mara only through the wet wall, the bucket, the prints and the scrubbed tap.

agency.reason: Moves are carried out as given; at M72 Mara grabs a burning branch past the move, and M4 adds a line of her own.

stakes.reason: Checks come often and failures cost: the lime spill, Anselm's anger, the burns from the sheet and the hose, a split palm carried forward and bleeding.

state.reason: Journal and memories are sound, but a few stale or wrong records, mostly hidden: Anselm barefoot into the morning, the papers folder and the hand burns dropped, threads naming a brigade that hasn't come.

romance.reason: The night at her door with the young wine has real tension and push and pull, and he hauls her off the burning ground, but by day it becomes a contest over who asks Bette what, and Mara's own wanting is never felt from inside.

violence.reason: The burns on hands, wrists and cheek and the palm splitting on the shutter hook are clear and physical, but quick, with little of the pain in her body after.
